# Consent tool config reference

Every field of the consent tool config, generated from the JSON Schema (`complykit consent tool config v1.0`).
What the fields mean, how the generator fills them and the rules the tool applies are in
[Consent tool config](/guide/config); the install steps are in
[Installing the consent tool](/guide/consent-tool).

The schema is published at `https://jeffjassky.github.io/complykit/schema/consent-tool-config.schema.json`. Point an editor at it with a
`$schema` key to get completion and validation while reading a config.

A config is a single JSON object. Hand edits invalidate `hash`, and the rescan reports them.
Some rules are not expressible in JSON Schema and are enforced by the generator and by the
tool itself (a `necessary` category must exist and be granted everywhere; no other category
may default to granted under `opt-in`; string overrides are checked against the banner copy
rules). Those are described in [Consent tool config](/guide/config).

"Required" means required in the written form, inside its parent object (`gtm.containers` is required only when `gtm` is present). A field with a default may be omitted.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `string` | yes |  | Config schema version "&lt;major&gt;.&lt;minor&gt;". pattern `^\d+\.\d+$` |
| `generatedFrom` | `object` | yes |  |  |
| `generatedFrom.runId` | `string` | yes |  | min length 1 |
| `generatedFrom.at` | `string` | yes |  | min length 1 |
| `generatedFrom.site` | `string` | yes |  | Registrable domain the scan ran against, e.g. example-shop.test. pattern `^[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$` |
| `generatedFrom.complykit` | `string` | yes |  | complykit package version that generated this. min length 1 |
| `generatedFrom.kb` | `string` |  |  | Knowledge-base version. min length 1 |
| `hash` | `string` | yes |  | sha-256 of the canonical JSON of every other field. pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `regimeSource` | one of | yes |  | Where the tool learns the visitor location. Never a third-party geo call; unknown ⇒ opt-in |
